scope: Lossless dynamic-workflow node-result persistence and run detail
before_change: Workflow detail projected false, zero, arrays and empty strings correctly, but settle_node replaced an explicit JSON null result with an empty object before storage. The old API test inserted rows directly and therefore missed the production persistence defect.
after_change: settle_node distinguishes an omitted result from an explicit null. Real transform execution persists and the API projects false, zero, arrays, null and empty strings without coercion; omitted results retain the empty-object default.
red_regression: Before the persistence change, real transform execution failed only the null case: the run-detail endpoint returned {} instead of null. The fixture was corrected to use valid plan site IDs before this behavioral failure was recorded.
visual_validation: No UI source changed. The current Studio amendment surface has separate opened responsive captures, scorecard and E2E evidence at docs/realignment/artifacts/workflow-studio/amendment-selective-reuse-2026-10-11/.

runtime.transport: FastAPI TestClient, real workflow supervisor and isolated SQLite state; no external requests
